meta.name: playwright-expert
meta.description: Use when writing E2E tests with Playwright, setting up test infrastructure, or debugging flaky browser tests. Invoke to write test scripts, create page objects, configure test fixtures, set up reporters, add CI integration, implement API mocking, or perform visual regression testing. Trigger terms: Playwright, E2E test, end-to-end, browser testing, automation, UI testing, visual testing, Page Object Model, test flakiness.

copy.tagline: 编写和调试 Playwright 端到端测试
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为 Web 应用编写可靠的 E2E 测试。
copy.tagline_en: Write and debug Playwright end-to-end tests
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to write reliable E2E tests for web applications.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会帮你编写和调试 Playwright 端到端测试，包括生成测试脚本、创建页面对象、配置测试夹具、设置报告器、集成 CI、实现 API 模拟和视觉回归测试。
howto.when: 当你提到 Playwright、E2E 测试、浏览器测试、自动化、UI 测试等关键词，或要求编写测试脚本、调试不稳定测试时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一个登录页面的 Playwright 测试。
say.note: Claude 会生成 Page Object 和测试文件。

say.text: 这个测试不稳定，帮我调试一下。
配置 Playwright 的 CI 集成。
say.note: Claude 会提供 CI 配置文件示例。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps you write and debug Playwright end-to-end tests, including generating test scripts, creating page objects, configuring test fixtures, setting up reporters, integrating CI, implementing API mocking, and performing visual regression testing.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention Playwright, E2E test, browser testing, automation, UI testing, or similar keywords, or when you ask to write test scripts or debug flaky tests.

say_en.text: Write a Playwright test for a login page.
say_en.note: Claude will generate Page Object and test file.

say_en.text: This test is flaky, help me debug it.
say_en.note: Claude will suggest using trace viewer and fixing waits.
Claude will provide CI config examples.
